name: Moon Princess

features.name: Princess powers
features.description: Three princesses trigger random powers: diamond creation, symbol removal or grid transformation.

features.name: Trinity Reels
features.description: Free spins with all three powers available.

review: Moon Princess is a cascading grid game with three random "princess powers" that can trigger on any spin. Its anime presentation has aged reasonably well and the free spins have a progressive multiplier. A dependable mid-2010s title worth trying in demo.
